description: An arrangement timeline: a position and a zoom, a viewport that scrolls and zooms around the pointer, a ruler, a navigator, tracks with resizable heights, lanes, marks, ranges such as loops, and clips that move, trim and fade, each with a native input for the keyboard. Its svelte adapter.

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/**
 * A stretch of a source laid on a lane: a recording, a pattern. Its parts
 * (the header, the handles, the fades) take the same `clip` name. Its own
 * native `<input type="range">` moves it from the keyboard and carries its
 * name, unless it is not `movable`.
 */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  clip,
  getAriaValueText,
  movable = true,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Clip>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  /** Returns how a position is announced. Defaults to the number. */
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Clip {...rest} {clip} {movable}>
  {#snippet children()}
    {@render content?.()}
    {#if movable}
      <parts.ClipInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {clip}
        {getAriaValueText}
      />
    {/if}
  {/snippet}
</parts.Clip>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** Shades a fade of the clip: its curve, in a 1 by 1 box. Style its `color` for the line, and `--clip-fade-shade` for the fill. */
let {
  clip,
  edge,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.ClipFadeIn>>, "children"> & {
  edge: "in" | "out";
} = $props();
</script>

{#snippet shade(state: {
  fill: string;
  line: string;
})}
  <path d={state.fill} style="fill: var(--clip-fade-shade, currentColor)" />
  <path
    d={state.line}
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="1.5"
    style="vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke"
  />
{/snippet}

{#if edge === "in"}
  <parts.ClipFadeIn {...rest} {clip}>
    {#snippet children(
      state
    )}
      {@render shade(state)}
    {/snippet}
  </parts.ClipFadeIn>
{:else}
  <parts.ClipFadeOut {...rest} {clip}>
    {#snippet children(
      state
    )}
      {@render shade(state)}
    {/snippet}
  </parts.ClipFadeOut>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** Sets one fade of the clip, by dragging or from the keyboard through its native input. A double click, or Enter, steps its shape. */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  clip,
  edge,
  getAriaValueText,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.ClipFadeInHandle>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  edge: "in" | "out";
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

{#if edge === "in"}
  <parts.ClipFadeInHandle {...rest} {clip}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.ClipFadeInInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {clip}
        {getAriaValueText}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.ClipFadeInHandle>
{:else}
  <parts.ClipFadeOutHandle {...rest} {clip}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.ClipFadeOutInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {clip}
        {getAriaValueText}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.ClipFadeOutHandle>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** Trims one edge of the clip, by dragging or from the keyboard through its native input: it moves where in the source the clip begins instead of stretching it. */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  clip,
  edge,
  getAriaValueText,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.ClipTrimStart>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  edge: "start" | "end";
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

{#if edge === "start"}
  <parts.ClipTrimStart {...rest} {clip}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.ClipTrimStartInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {clip}
        {getAriaValueText}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.ClipTrimStart>
{:else}
  <parts.ClipTrimEnd {...rest} {clip}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.ClipTrimEndInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {clip}
        {getAriaValueText}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.ClipTrimEnd>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** A point of interest at a `value`. With `movable`, a drag or the arrows move it. The `mark` name defaults to the value. */
let {
  mark,
  value,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Mark>>, "mark"> & { mark?: string } =
  $props();
</script>

<parts.Mark {...rest} mark={mark ?? String(value)} {value} />

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** An edge of the navigator's window: dragging it zooms, holding the other edge still. */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  edge,
  getAriaValueText,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.NavigatorStart>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  edge: "end" | "start";
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

{#if edge === "start"}
  <parts.NavigatorStart {...rest}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.NavigatorStartInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {getAriaValueText}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.NavigatorStart>
{:else}
  <parts.NavigatorEnd {...rest}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.NavigatorEndInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {getAriaValueText}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.NavigatorEnd>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** The stretch the viewport shows, inside the navigator: dragging it scrolls. Its native input moves it from the keyboard. */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  getAriaValueText,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.NavigatorWindow>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.NavigatorWindow {...rest}>
  {#snippet children()}
    {@render content?.()}
    <parts.NavigatorWindowInput
      aria-describedby={describedBy}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
      {getAriaValueText}
    />
  {/snippet}
</parts.NavigatorWindow>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/**
 * A stretch laid over a lane, such as a loop or a selection. Its edges take
 * the same `range` name. Its own native `<input type="range">` moves it from
 * the keyboard and carries its name, unless it is not `movable`.
 */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  getAriaValueText,
  movable = true,
  range,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Range>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Range {...rest} {movable} {range}>
  {#snippet children()}
    {@render content?.()}
    {#if movable}
      <parts.RangeInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {getAriaValueText}
        {range}
      />
    {/if}
  {/snippet}
</parts.Range>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** Resizes one edge of a range, by dragging or from the keyboard through its native input. */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  edge,
  getAriaValueText,
  range,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.RangeStart>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  edge: "end" | "start";
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
  /** The name of the range it belongs to. */
  range: string;
} = $props();
</script>

{#if edge === "start"}
  <parts.RangeStart {...rest} {range}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.RangeStartInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {getAriaValueText}
        {range}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.RangeStart>
{:else}
  <parts.RangeEnd {...rest} {range}>
    {#snippet children()}
      {@render content?.()}
      <parts.RangeEndInput
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        aria-label={label}
        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
        {getAriaValueText}
        {range}
      />
    {/snippet}
  </parts.RangeEnd>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/**
 * The lane that moves the position: a press jumps to the pointer and a drag
 * scrubs, on the grid unless Cmd/Ctrl is held. It holds the native
 * `<input type="range">` that takes focus and the keys and carries the name.
 */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  getAriaValueText,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.Ruler>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
  /** Returns how the position is announced, e.g. `"bar 3, beat 2"`. Defaults to the number. */
  getAriaValueText?: (value: number, duration: number) => string;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.Ruler {...rest}>
  {#snippet children()}
    {@render content?.()}
    <parts.RulerInput
      aria-describedby={describedBy}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
      {getAriaValueText}
    />
  {/snippet}
</parts.Ruler>

<script lang="ts">
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { type Known, parts } from "./parts";

/** Sets the track's height: by dragging, or from the keyboard through its native input. A double-click gives the height up. */
let {
  "aria-describedby": describedBy,
  "aria-label": label,
  "aria-labelledby": labelledBy,
  children: content,
  track,
  ...rest
}: Omit<Known<ComponentProps<typeof parts.TrackResizeHandle>>, "children"> & {
  "aria-describedby"?: string;
  "aria-label"?: string;
  "aria-labelledby"?: string;
  children?: Snippet;
} = $props();
</script>

<parts.TrackResizeHandle {...rest} {track}>
  {#snippet children()}
    {@render content?.()}
    <parts.TrackResizeInput
      aria-describedby={describedBy}
      aria-label={label}
      aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
      {track}
    />
  {/snippet}
</parts.TrackResizeHandle>

import { timeline } from "@audio-ui/primitives/timeline";
import { createParts } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/primitive";

/** Which element each part is. */
export const parts = createParts(timeline, {
  clip: "div",
  clipFadeIn: "svg",
  clipFadeInHandle: "div",
  clipFadeInInput: "input",
  clipFadeOut: "svg",
  clipFadeOutHandle: "div",
  clipFadeOutInput: "input",
  clipHeader: "div",
  clipInput: "input",
  clipTrimEnd: "div",
  clipTrimEndInput: "input",
  clipTrimStart: "div",
  clipTrimStartInput: "input",
  lane: "div",
  mark: "div",
  navigator: "div",
  navigatorEnd: "div",
  navigatorEndInput: "input",
  navigatorStart: "div",
  navigatorStartInput: "input",
  navigatorWindow: "div",
  navigatorWindowInput: "input",
  range: "div",
  rangeEnd: "div",
  rangeEndInput: "input",
  rangeInput: "input",
  rangeStart: "div",
  rangeStartInput: "input",
  playhead: "div",
  root: "div",
  ruler: "div",
  rulerInput: "input",
  track: "div",
  trackHeader: "div",
  trackResizeHandle: "div",
  trackResizeInput: "input",
  viewport: "div",
});

/** The props a part names, without the open index signature that would turn them into `unknown` under `Omit`. */
export type Known<T> = {
  [K in keyof T as string extends K
    ? never
    : number extends K
      ? never
      : symbol extends K
        ? never
        : K]: T[K];
};

name: timeline-svelte
